title: Session limits
description: The edge's session limits for one pack, as data (Architect ruling A21; AGENT-16: agents do not set thresholds, so no number lives in code). The clock skew leeway applies to both iat and exp on the injected clock (INV-21), and must stay below the verifier's maximum lifetime. SYNTHETIC configuration (AGENT-25). Changing a value is a pack change reviewed by the Founders.

pack_id.description: The pack's vertical prefix, as in pack.v1 pack_id.

clock_skew_s.description: Seconds of leeway on iat and exp.
